question: Who among the following was the first Indian to win an individual gold medal at the Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Bindra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Abhinav Bindra is a distinguished player in shooting games.
 
• Abhinav Bindra made history in Beijing 2008 Olympics by becoming the first Indian to win an individual gold medal.
 
• He is the first Indian to have held concurrently the world and Olympic titles for the men's 10-meter air rifle event, having earned those honors at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
 
• Abhinav Bindra has also won seven medals at the Commonwealth Games and three medals at the Asian Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba818e4ade54d0d6fc7afc7a668472291d45217b9d51e366a0e3738c4a0c6e35.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Abhinav Bindra was born in Zirkpur, Punjab.
 
• Bindra was the youngest participant in the 1998 Commonwealth Games. He was also the youngest Indian participant at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney.
 
• He received more than 150 medals in his 22-year career.
 
• He is the recipient of the Padma Bhushan from the Government of India, He also received the Arjun award, and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna award, India's highest sports award.
